pages.text: $(bold)SAFETY BULLETIN #41$()$(br)$(bold)RE: STOP TOUCHING THE CRYSTALS$()$(br2)Raw $(l:orsa_rd/acheronite_crystals)Acheronite Shards$(/l) are $(bold)-189°C$(). Carrying them gives you frostbite. This is not a suggestion. This is thermodynamics.
$(italic)We can see your temperature dropping from orbit. Please stop.$()

pages.title: Stages
pages.text: $(bold)Holding a shard:$()$(li)$(bold)Numb:$() Slowness I$(li)$(bold)Spreading:$() Slowness II$(li)$(bold)Tissue damage:$() Slowness II and damage$(li)$(bold)After 30s:$() Mining Fatigue II$(br2)$(bold)In your pack:$() the same stages, three times slower.

pages.title: Grace Period
pages.text: Time before stages begin, by armor:$(li)None: 10s$(li)Tier 1 Insulated: 25s$(li)Tier 2 Heated: 45s$(li)Tier 3 EVA: 90s$(li)Acheronite or Lined EVA: $(bold)immune$()$(br2)$(bold)Recovery:$() put the shard down. The cold fades slowly.
